title: EvPFC: code, label draws and per-run results for 'Evidential priors for semi-supervised picture fuzzy clustering with noisy partial labels in single-cell multi-omics data'

creators.name: Thong, Pham Huy
creators.affiliation: Hanoi University of Industry, Hanoi, Vietnam

creators.name: Huan, Phung The
creators.affiliation: Thai Nguyen University of Information and Communication Technology, Thai Nguyen, Vietnam

description: Code, label draws and per-run results of the article 'Evidential priors for semi-supervised picture fuzzy clustering with noisy partial labels in single-cell multi-omics data' (submitted to Pattern Analysis and Applications). The repository contains the EvPFC model, all experiment scripts (encoders, baselines, scMDC/scEMC wrappers, robustness checks), the explicit label draws of every run, the raw and consolidated per-run results, and the scripts that rebuild every table and figure of the paper.
